name: The Wilds
tagline: Seven trials. One Weaver behind all of them.
introText: Seven monsters guard the Wilds — strength, endurance, resilience, adaptation, precision, raw weight, and repetition under fatigue. None of them wait for you to be ready. Beyond all seven, something older is watching.
completionText: The Wilds are over. Minotaur, Leviathan, Behemoth, Hydra, Arachne, Mammoth, and Basilisk have all fallen — and the Weaver has fallen with them. Whatever you were when you started, you are not that anymore.

territoryLore.theTerritory: The Wilds don't remember the men who came before you. Every trail here belongs to something with teeth.
territoryLore.whatDwellsHere: Old muscle, older instinct. Creatures shaped by hunger and repetition — no strategy, no mercy, just weight and motion, over and over, until something breaks.
territoryLore.huntersPurpose: You come here to prove your body still answers when it's told to keep going. There is no shortcut through the Wilds. Only through.
territoryLore.transition: Choose your contract. The ground doesn't care which one you pick.
